test_objective_coefficients_are_not_matr: for row in model.linear_constraints() for var in model.row_nonzeros(row)]

for row in model.linear_constraints() for var in model.row_nonzeros(row)]
    entries += [("objective", var.name, model.objective.get_linear_coefficient(var))
                for var in model.variables() if model.objective.get_linear_coefficient(var)]
test_variable_bounds_are_not_matrix_entr: for row in model.linear_constraints() for var in model.row_nonzeros(row)]

for row in model.linear_constraints() for var in model.row_nonzeros(row)]
    entries += [("bounds", var.name, b) for var in model.variables()
                for b in (var.lower_bound, var.upper_bound) if b not in (0, float("inf"), float("-inf"))]
